title: test: record CI repair acceptance criteria

requirements.text: Research first: how the landing step currently observes and records a red check, and where the review-cycle cap (anti-thrash) already lives so the fix cycle reuses it.

On a red required check, dispatch the implement phase with the failing check's log excerpt, at most a configured number of cycles (default small), then fall back to today's `failed` record with the check named.
Distinguish infrastructure flake (rerun) from a real failure; count every cycle against the budget ceilings; never touch branch protection or the check definitions.
A planted lint failure on a goal PR is repaired automatically within the cap (control, red first).
requirements.note: control tests the dispatch of the repair, not an end-to-end repair

requirements.text: A failure that cannot be repaired within the cap ends as `failed`, naming the check.
Cycles appear in the phase cost report.
requirements.note: measured via host phase_report; diff shows ci-repair timing kind but no phase_report.py change

title: docs(sdlc): bind agent and contributor entry points to the Definition of Done

requirements.text: Add concise English AGENTS/contributor entry pointers to the canonical factory guidance and app-owned native Windows evidence/DoD profile. Preserve the user's Terra/medium requirement, central clarification channel and minimum necessary independent review.
Document resolved canonical guidance repository/path and app-specific Python/PySide6 scope; no implicit .NET/Blazor conversion or app-platform runtime membership.

If factory.config is needed by the selected harness workflow, use only the published closed schema and validate it. Do not invent native-profile keys or automatically enable hooks, MCP, credentials or system configuration.
requirements.note: conditional ('if factory.config is needed'); cannot tell

requirements.text: Provide a minimal PR/work-order evidence checklist covering owner/ACs, exact build/head, local checks, independent review, required CI, real user evidence or justified scope-based N/A, open gaps and post-merge verification.
requirements.note: template lacks an explicit post-merge verification item

requirements.text: The checklist explicitly separates artifact completion, code verification and runtime SystemOK; missing mandatory evidence keeps the relevant work item open.
Demonstrate a reproducible fresh-session walkthrough from repository landing/agent instructions to issue, owner, DoD and evidence path. Resolve contradictory or stale pointers.
requirements.note: walkthrough demonstration is process evidence, not in the diff

requirements.text: All new repository/GitHub prose is English; multilingual functional samples stay intact.
